## Highlights of your journey

In Caracas, you will explore the historic centre, the National Pantheon, the Capitol and Simón Bolívar’s birthplace, and head up into Ávila National Park.

Your journey then continues to Canaima, with boat trips on the lagoon, visits to Sapo and Acha waterfalls, a trip to Angel Falls and a free day with optional excursions.

After Canaima, spend several days on Margarita Island, relaxing on the beach and taking a sightseeing tour of its main historic sites.

Before the journey ends, visit the Santa Teresa Estate and discover Venezuelan rum production.
